title: Foo Bar Add Projection
description: A 3M-row Orders table is sorted by (customerId, orderTs), but a planted query filters by productSku and sorts by orderTs DESC — forcing a full scan. Add a ClickHouse projection (through Moose's typed OlapTable config on `moose-initialized`, or raw `ALTER TABLE … ADD PROJECTION` on `base-rt`) so the secondary access pattern is served from a re-sorted projection without disturbing the primary key.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must add a ClickHouse projection to serve a secondary access pattern that is currently scanning the entire Orders table — measured both through Moose's typed config and through raw ClickHouse SQL.

tasks.description: Add a projection to the Orders table so that filtering by productSku and ordering by orderTs DESC runs at least 3x faster, then materialize it for the existing 3M rows.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse with a 3M-row Orders table sorted by (customerId, orderTs). On `moose-initialized`, the table lives in `local.Orders` behind a Moose project at /workspace/moose-project (CH on :18123 with auth, brought up by `moose dev --dockerless`). On `base-rt`, the same table is created directly in `local.Orders` on supervised CH (:8123, no auth). Slow query at /workspace/queries/top_orders_by_sku.sql.
